profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Lowes
profile.summary: Results-driven Lead Software Engineer with deep expertise in Full Stack Development, primarily using Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, REST APIs, ReactJS, Kafka and SQL/NoSQL. I have a solid track record of designing and delivering scalable applications, optimizing system performance, and aligning engineering efforts with business priorities. My experience includes architecting and building solutions using Microservices Architecture, enabling modular, maintainable, and scalable systems. As I advance toward a Principal Engineer role, I aim to drive architectural decisions, mentor development teams, and champion best practices in modern software engineering.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Charlotte, North Carolina, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Led the design and development of a next-gen Competitive Intelligence platform to replace Stylumia, enabling faster and scalable insights for business decision-making.
• Built microservices architecture using Spring Boot and MongoDB, ensuring modularity, scalability, and high availability.
• Developed an intuitive React-based UI with reusable components for seamless visualization and exploration of competitive insights.
• Integrated with GCP BigQuery and DataProc for large-scale data ingestion, transformation, and advanced analytics on multi-domain datasets (Sales, Finance, Enterprise Items, etc.).
• Automated workflows using GCP Composer (Airflow) for scheduling ETL pipelines and orchestrating cross-domain data processing.
• Implemented secure APIs and optimized read-heavy operations via Looker API integrations for dashboards and reporting.
• Delivered a modern, cloud-native solution that improved performance, reduced dependency on third-party tools, and provided cost-efficient scaling on Google Cloud Platform.•

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Redesigned and re-architected of the legacy Out for Repair system to align with modern platform standards and best practices.
• Led data migration efforts from RMS Reporting DB to Modern Rail, ensuring accuracy and completeness of historical records.
• Develop vendor restriction platform with Kotlin, Spring Boot, MongoDB, React JS, enhancing security and operations.
• Improve vendor management processes, boosting efficiency and reducing costs.
• Lead team to implement solutions, achieving measurable system efficiency improvements.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams for seamless integration and functionality.
• Analyze and resolve complex issues, maintaining system integrity and providing critical support.
• Led cross-functional team in implementing cutting-edge solutions, driving substantial improvements in system efficiency and overall performance.
• Engineered comprehensive analytics tools, uncovering pivotal insights into Pro sales and margins, facilitating data-driven decision-making.
• Fostered seamless integration across departments, ensuring optimal functionality and alignment with organizational objectives.
• Swiftly diagnosed and resolved complex technical issues, maintaining system integrity and providing critical support to enhance operational stability.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Enhanced digital experience with Groovy, Kotlin, Spring Boot, React JS, AWS, boosting site performance.
• Collaborated with teams to integrate and deploy solutions, resolving technical challenges.
• Implemented GVP capabilities, leading to significant operational improvements.
• Developed robust tech stack with Groovy, Kotlin, Spring Boot, React JS, AWS for advanced digital solutions.
• Led implementation of Passport JS and MongoDB, improving system security and data management.
positions.insights: Skills: RESTful WebServices · Spring Cloud · Apache Kafka · Spring Boot · MongoDB

positions.title: Lead Engineer
positions.description:
• Led development of Target.com features using Kotlin, Spring Boot, MongoDB, Kafka, and React JS, enhancing user experience.
• Migrated data from vendor PIM tool to in-house system using Python, improving data management efficiency.
• Created enterprise upload services for Google Cloud and Adobe Scene7, streamlining digital resource management.
• Architected enterprise signing system, optimizing workflow processes.
• Designed and implemented Apache Airflow tasks for workflow management, ensuring seamless operations.
• Orchestrated seamless migration from vendor PIM tool to in-house system, leveraging Python to ensure data integrity and enhance operational efficiency
• Architected enterprise signing system and designed DAGs for Apache Airflow, streamlining workflow management and boosting productivity
• Engineered enterprise upload services for digital resource management, optimizing storage utilization across Google Cloud and Adobe Scene7 platforms
• Led cross-functional teams in implementing microservices architecture, integrating MongoDB, Kafka, and React JS to enhance system scalability and performance.

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description:
• Converted monolith to microservices for better performance, scalability; deployed using Docker, Kubernetes
• Implemented pipeline for microservices deployment, improved efficiency with Drone, Docker, Kubernetes
• Enhanced digital content upload flow by transitioning to microservices; utilized Kotlin, Spring Boot, React
• Optimized system performance by restructuring architecture; deployed with Docker, Drone, Kubernetes
• Developed and deployed microservices architecture; used Kotlin, Spring Boot, React, MongoDB, Kafka.

positions.title: EUI Smart Device Senior Cloud Engineer
positions.description:
• Redesigned and developed a CMS using Micro Service Architecture and Spring Boot REST web services.
•  Created scalable REST APIs for LeZone app, improving user recommendations for games and apps.
• Utilized Java, Spring Boot, React JS, PostgreSQL, Kafka, and Docker to enhance system performance.
• Addressed high transaction volumes, ensuring seamless user experiences and reliable data processing.
• Achieved measurable improvements in system efficiency and user engagement.
positions.insights: Skills: RESTful WebServices · Spring Cloud · Apache Kafka · React.js · Material-UI

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained custom modules in WSO2 Identity Server, reducing external support dependency.
• Customized user management module for enhanced data control, aligning with company needs.
• Promoted WSO2 Identity Server adoption for Single Sign-On, increasing internal team efficiency.
• Implemented Open ID Single Logout Specification, enhancing security and user experience.
• Utilized Java, WSO2 Identity Server, and PostgreSQL to efficiently deliver project milestones.
positions.insights: Skills: RESTful WebServices · Spring Cloud · Apache Kafka

positions.title: Senior Software Developer Engineer
positions.description:
• Improved technical practices and development tools, leading to enhanced efficiency and performance.
• Implemented Jenkins for continuous integration, streamlining the build process and reducing errors.
• Conducted stakeholder meetings to gain deep system understanding and address issues effectively.
• Developed a carrier inventory management system, resolving system loopholes and improving reliability.
• Provided production support for manufacturing execution systems, ensuring smooth operations.

positions.title: Sr. Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
• Developed prototype applications for client demos, securing multiple project acquisitions.
• Resolved customer issues through debugging, enhancing client satisfaction and retention.
• Assisted in project design and development, ensuring streamlined processes and timely delivery.
• Promoted three times in four years, showcasing consistent performance and dedication.
• Utilized Java/J2EE, Spring MVC, Jenkins, MySQL, JQuery, HTML, CSS to deliver high-quality solutions.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
• Analyzed logistics and energy domains, enhancing solution accuracy and understanding.
• Designed and developed Jasper reporting module, boosting reporting efficiency.
• Collaborated with QA to ensure quality-tested deliverables for each Sprint.
• Utilized Java/J2EE, Spring MVC, Jenkins, and MySQL to streamline development.
• Achieved measurable improvements in project delivery timelines.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Learned ActionScript and Cairngorm architecture, enhancing project capabilities.
• Integrated Spring and Hibernate, improving project efficiency and scalability.
• Added Google Calendar support, increasing user functionality and engagement.
• Adapted to startup culture, gaining versatile experience in dynamic environments.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Contributed to a key project, rapidly integrating new technologies to enhance efficiency.
• Implemented internationalization and localization, improving global reach and usability.
• Collaborated with project manager to develop comprehensive documentation, ensuring clarity.
• Utilized Java/J2EE to deliver measurable improvements, boosting project outcomes.
